title: Agency and Center Identification
slide_intent: Teach designers to distinguish an institution from one of its centers. A reader should be able to identify both the parent organization and the specific local sender.
strategic_value: NASA can give a center prominence through typographic weight while keeping the agency identity intact.
demonstration: The upper configuration pairs the mark with the agency name in Helvetica Light. The lower configuration retains both and adds John F. Kennedy Space Center in Helvetica Medium.
practical_value: Select the two-part agency configuration for NASA as a whole. Add the center name in the prescribed heavier weight when identifying that center.

content_islands.name: Configuration guidance
content_islands.spec: Arrange the title and explanatory text across the upper band. Keep the agency and center descriptions distinct.

content_islands.name: Agency identification
content_islands.spec: Below the first rule, stack the logotype and two-line agency name on a common left edge.

content_islands.name: Center identification
content_islands.spec: Repeat the upper group below a second rule and add the center name as the final, heavier line.
